protocol.description: This protocol allows clients to emulate a physical pointer device. The requests are mostly mirror opposites of those specified in wl_pointer.

interface.name: zwlr_virtual_pointer_v1
interface.description: This protocol allows a client to emulate a physical pointer device. The requests are mostly mirror opposites of those specified in wl_pointer.

request.name: motion
request.description:
The pointer has moved by a relative amount to the previous request.
Values are in the global compositor space.

request.name: motion_absolute
request.description: The pointer has moved to an absolute position. Values are in the global compositor space, where x_extent and y_extent describe the coordinate space of the (x, y) values.

arg.name: x_extent
arg.summary: coordinate space upper bound for x

arg.name: y_extent
arg.summary: coordinate space upper bound for y

request.name: button
request.description: A button was pressed or released.

arg.name: value
arg.summary: length of vector in surface-local coordinates

request.name: frame

description.summary: end of a pointer event sequence

request.description: Indicates the set of events that logically belong together.

request.name: axis_source
request.description: Source information for scroll and other axis.

request.name: axis_stop
request.description: Stop notification for scroll and other axes.

arg.name: axis
arg.summary: the axis stopped with this event

request.name: axis_discrete
request.description:
Discrete step information for scroll and other axes.
This event allows the client to extend data normally sent using the axis event with discrete value.

arg.name: value
arg.summary: length of vector in surface-local coordinates

interface.name: zwlr_virtual_pointer_manager_v1
interface.description: This object allows clients to create individual virtual pointer objects.

request.name: create_virtual_pointer
request.description: Creates a new virtual pointer. The optional seat is a suggestion to the compositor.

request.name: create_virtual_pointer_with_output

description.summary: Create a new virtual pointer with the output suggestion

request.description: Creates a new virtual pointer. The seat and the output arguments are optional. If the seat argument is set, the compositor should assign the input device to the requested seat. If the output argument is set, the compositor should map the input device to the requested output.
